description: This Swift source file defines the DevicePairingApprovalPrompter class, which manages device pairing requests in a macOS application, handling pending requests, presenting alerts, processing user responses, and integrating with network services for device approval and rejection.

classes.name: DevicePairingApprovalPrompter
classes.description: A singleton class responsible for managing device pairing approval prompts, including handling requests, presenting alerts, and processing user responses asynchronously.

methods.name: start
methods.description: Initiates the pairing prompt processing by starting the push task.

methods.name: stop
methods.description: Stops the pairing prompt processing, clears pending requests, and resets tracking state.

methods.name: loadPendingRequestsFromGateway
methods.description: Fetches the list of pending pairing requests from the gateway asynchronously and updates the internal queue.

methods.name: apply
methods.description: Updates the internal queue with new data and triggers presentation of next prompt if applicable.

methods.name: updatePendingCounts
methods.description: Updates counts of pending requests and repair requests.

methods.name: presentNextIfNeeded
methods.description: Displays the next pairing request alert if the system is not stopping or already presenting.

methods.name: presentAlert
methods.description: Presents an alert for a specific pairing request and handles the user's response.

methods.name: handleAlertResponse
methods.description: Processes user response to pairing alert, approves or rejects requests accordingly, and updates state.

methods.name: approve
methods.description: Sends approval for a device pairing request via network and logs the operation.

methods.name: reject
methods.description: Sends rejection for a device pairing request via network.

methods.name: handle
methods.description: Handles incoming push notifications related to device pairing requests or resolutions.

methods.name: enqueue
methods.description: Adds a new pairing request to the queue if not already present, then updates counts and possibly presents an alert.

methods.name: handleResolved
methods.description: Handles resolution events for pairing requests, updating the queue and logs accordingly.

methods.name: describe
methods.description: Generates a human-readable description string for a pairing request.
